name: Twilight Traveller
detailed_description:
Twilight Traveller takes place in a fantasy world currently experiencing a dark age. Crystals that channelled the worlds magic have fractured, an illness has spread, and goblins have appeared.

You play as the traveller, a character who has wandered the lands looking for a place to call home and who is on their own until they meet Robert the frog. Robert believes the illness can be cured by returning magic to the crystals and asks for your help to do so. In the process, you’ll be able to harness restored magic to build a home and befriend Robert, if you chose to do so, or just embrace the isolation.

Developed solo, Twilight Traveller is designed to be a quiet sanctuary from the stresses of the world.

Explore the world to discover lore, enjoy activities like camping & fishing, and soak in the atmosphere. Feeling lonely? why not invite Robert to keep you company whilst doing activities!


Collect elemental essence from crystal shards found throughout the world.  But crystal shards aren't the only thing waiting to be found! discover other items whilst exploring & foraging, extracting elemental essence from them, or perhaps adding them to your cooking recipes.

Use your collected elemental essence to reawaken the anchor crystals, the main crystals through which the worlds magic flows. With the crystals restored, the world comes back to life & Robert will be able to use the restored magic to help you build a home.


Upon reawakening the first anchor crystal, Robert will use its restored magic to help rebuild one of the many ruined homes scattered across the land.

Once restored, your home becomes your sanctuary. Use elemental essence to fabricate furniture, decorations, and other customisations, turning the space into something uniquely yours.

short_description: Flee to the wilderness and build a peaceful sanctuary in a world where magic has collapsed. Reawaken fractured crystals, bond with Robert the frog, and restore balance in this cozy isometric adventure with light survival elements.
